# SOUVA Mobile Pet Grooming

> Luxury 1-on-1 autonomous solar mobile pet grooming serving San Francisco and the Peninsula across 38 covered ZIP codes.

## About
SOUVA CORP operates a zero-emission, 100% solar lithium battery-powered mobile grooming fleet. We deliver cage-free salon experiences directly to client doorsteps in San Francisco, San Mateo County, and North Santa Clara County.

- Official Domain: https://www.souvagrooming.com
- Telephone Concierge: +1 (415) 375-5823
- Email: info@souvagrooming.com
- Hours: Monday - Sunday, 8:30 AM - 7:00 PM PST
- Legal Entity: SOUVA CORP (California Registered Corporation)

## Core Services & Pricing
- Bath & Brush Refresh: Warm hydro-massage bath with Hydra® botanical shampoo, hand blow-dry, ear cleaning, and nail trim.
- Bath & Tidy: Refresh plus sanitary trim, paw pad cleanup, and facial scissor shaping.
- Essential Full Groom: Complete breed haircut, all-over styling, bath, and hygiene care.
- Signature SOUVA Grooming: Master scissor sculpting, plush coat styling 1/2"+, blueberry facial, and bandana finish.
- Multi-Dog Promotion: 20% discount applied automatically to the second dog in the same visit.
